predecessors.note: 'ratified the Treaty of Vereeniging on 31 May 1902'; British troops occupied Bloemfontein 'by 13 March 1900' and the page gives a British annexation declared 'on 6 October 1900' (the Free State dossier has 28 May 1900 from its own page).

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no Orange River Colony: its Free Orange State row ends in 1899). The page gives no boundaries or area; the colony is the former republic, drawn as the Orange Free State region (the Free State province, about 121,000 km2 by the gazetteer; confidence 2).

region.text: the former Orange Free State: the colony 'created after Britain first occupied (1900) and then annexed (1902)'

ledger.note: 31 May 1902: the Orange Free State, already occupied since 13 March 1900, ratifies the Treaty of Vereeniging and becomes the British Orange River Colony. 'ratified the Treaty of Vereeniging on 31 May 1902'; the page's intro: 'annexed (1902)'.

region.text: the former Orange Free State: the colony 'created after Britain first occupied (1900) and then annexed (1902)'

ledger.note: 31 May 1910: the colony enters the Union of South Africa as the Orange Free State Province. 'Under the imperial act by which unification was established (31 May 1910) the colony entered the Union under the style of the Orange Free State Province.'

certainty.note: Former republic boundaries; no change is dated.

sources.title: Orange River Colony
sources.note: Occupation of Bloemfontein 13 March 1900; annexation 6 October 1900; Vereeniging 31 May 1902; self-government 27 November 1907; Union 31 May 1910

notes: Cliopatria has no Orange River Colony. Starts at the Treaty of Vereeniging (31 May 1902) because the Free Orange State dossier (af-07-b) carries the occupation from 13 March 1900. The page's dates disagree with its sibling's: annexation 'on 6 October 1900' (this page) against 28 May 1900 (Orange Free State page, in the free-orange-state ledger); the intro says 'annexed (1902)'. Not typed: self-government on 27 November 1907 (Abraham Fischer premier). No boundary or area on the page. Counterpart needing a dossier: union-of-south-africa (see transvaal-colony). Gazetteer: 'Orange Free State' is a region alias of admin1 Free State.
